title: Gaussian Mixture Model with EM
signature: def gmm_em(X: np.ndarray, means: np.ndarray, variances: np.ndarray, weights: np.ndarray, n_iter: int, reg_covar: float = 1e-6) -> tuple
hints: E-step in log space: log r_ik = log pi_k + log N(x_i | mu_k, diag(var_k)). Normalize each row with log-sum-exp.
The log-sum-exp of each row is that point's log-likelihood. Sum those over points, before the M-step, to get the history entry.
M-step: N_k = sum_i r_ik, pi = N_k / n, mu_k = r_k^T X / N_k, var_k = r_k^T (X - mu_k_new)^2 / N_k + reg_covar.
Use the NEW means in the variance update.
